title.narrative: Development of IEPM Strategy for CTP South Sudan.

description.narrative: The CTP office in South Sudan is undertaking a process of strategic planning for its country programme in South Sudan. This process is following the CAFOD Integral Ecology Programme Model (IEPM) to plan and deliver the strategic plan for the country programme also known as the Programme Strategy for South Sudan. As part of this process CTP has been carrying out a number of partners and stakeholders' consultations to gather input for the Programme Strategy. Consultations have been on a number of areas including the contextual situation analysis, nature of problems and issues affecting communities in South Sudan, vulnerable people and communities affected by these problems. CTP has also carried out reviews of some of its programmes, previous strategies as well as monitoring reports with valuable community feedback. As part of the consultation process CTP would like to bring together its partners and stakeholders to discuss the nature of problems and their causes affecting South Sudan and synthesize all this information together. This would be in the form of a three-day workshop to understand the bigger picture of the nature of problem/s, their causes, affecting vulnerable communities and people in South Sudan and how these can be resolved.
